1.title: Adv: Subsets (W1)
1.desc:
Given an integer array of unique elements, return all possible subsets (the power set). The solution set must not contain duplicate subsets. Print them sorted by length, then lexicographically. Empty subset is printed as 'EMPTY'.

**Input Format**
First line: N
Second line: N integers

**Output Format**
Subsets, one per line.

1.title: Adv: Permutations (W1)
1.desc:
Given an array of distinct integers, return all the possible permutations. Print them in lexicographical order.

**Input Format**
First line: N
Second line: N integers

**Output Format**
Permutations, one per line.

1.title: Adv: Combination Sum (W1)
1.desc:
Given an array of distinct integers candidates and a target integer target, return a list of all unique combinations of candidates where the chosen numbers sum to target. The same number may be chosen unlimited number of times.

**Input Format**
First line: N
Second line: N integers
Third line: Target

**Output Format**
Combinations sorted lexicographically, one per line.

1.title: Adv: Minimum Path Sum (W1)
1.desc:
Given a m x n grid filled with non-negative numbers, find a path from top left to bottom right, which minimizes the sum of all numbers along its path. You can only move down or right.

**Input Format**
First line: m n
Next m lines: n integers each

**Output Format**
Minimum sum integer.

1.title: Adv: Coin Change (W1)
1.desc:
You are given an integer array coins representing coins of different denominations and an integer amount. Return the fewest number of coins that you need to make up that amount.

**Input Format**
First line: N
Second line: N integers
Third line: Amount

**Output Format**
Minimum coins, or -1 if not possible.

1.title: Adv: Longest Increasing Subsequence (W1)
1.desc:
Given an integer array nums, return the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.

**Input Format**
First line: N
Second line: N integers

**Output Format**
Integer length.

1.title: Adv: Number of Islands (W1)
1.desc:
Given an m x n 2D binary grid which represents a map of '1's (land) and '0's (water), return the number of islands.

**Input Format**
First line: m n
Next m lines: n space-separated '0's and '1's

**Output Format**
Integer count.

1.title: Adv: Flood Fill (W1)
1.desc:
Perform a flood fill on the image starting from the pixel (sr, sc) with newColor.

**Input Format**
First line: m n
Next m lines: n integers
Last line: sr sc newColor

**Output Format**
The modified grid.

1.title: Adv: Max Area of Island (W1)
1.desc:
Find the maximum area of an island in a given 2D array.

**Input Format**
First line: m n
Next m lines: n integers (0 or 1)

**Output Format**
Integer area.

1.title: Adv: Top K Frequent Elements (W1)
1.desc:
Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the k most frequent elements. Sort the output array.

**Input Format**
First line: N
Second line: N integers
Third line: k

**Output Format**
Space-separated k elements in ascending order.

1.title: Adv: Sort Characters By Frequency (W1)
1.desc:
Given a string s, sort it in decreasing order based on the frequency of the characters.

**Input Format**
Single string S.

**Output Format**
Sorted string.

1.title: Adv: Kth Largest Element (W1)
1.desc:
Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the kth largest element in the array.

**Input Format**
First line: N
Second line: N integers
Third line: k

**Output Format**
Single integer.

1.title: Adv: LRU Cache Simulation (W1)
1.desc:
Simulate an LRU Cache. Implement PUT key value and GET key. Print the result of every GET query.

**Input Format**
First line: Capacity
Second line: Number of Operations Q
Next Q lines: 'PUT key value' or 'GET key'

**Output Format**
One line for each GET operation result.
